_comment: Real team personas. Approvers form a severity hierarchy (Supervisor -> Manager -> VP, escalating by severity); contributors are specialists who weigh in on their domain but do NOT approve work orders.

normal.name: James Kowalski
normal.scope: Shift decisions, escalations, approves work orders

escalated.name: Sarah Chen
escalated.scope: Production impact, cost trade-offs, ops-level approval
escalated.applies_when: elevated severity or cases with significant production/cost impact

executive.name: Michael Osei
executive.applies_when: critical / emergency cases, or portfolio-level financial or risk exposure

diagnosis.name: Priya Nair
diagnosis.concern: reviews diagnostic evidence, RUL and root cause

sensor.name: Raj Iyer
sensor.concern: verifies sensor/signal health and data validity

safety.name: Lisa Park
safety.concern: validates LOTO, permits, PPE and compliance
